ingredients.name: Biotin
ingredients.shortDesc: Biotin is known to improve keratin structure
ingredients.longDesc: Biotin is known to improve keratin structure. Keratin is an essential protein that helps in boosting hair strength and density. Regular consumption of biotin along with other vitamins help increase hair quality by boosting density and volume.

ingredients.name: Zinc
ingredients.longDesc: Zinc has hair strengthening properties. It also has DHT blocking properties. DHT is a hormone known to boost hair thinning. Regular consumption of zinc helps strengthen follicles and brittle hair, reducing hair thinning.

ingredients.name: Vitamin A
ingredients.shortDesc: Vitamin A is known to boost hair health, adding moisture to the scalp
ingredients.longDesc: Vitamin A is known to boost hair health, adding moisture to the scalp. It does that by regulating and maintaining sebum production, which keeps the scalp healthy. It also helps curb hair thinning by nourishing the scalp.

ingredients.name: Vitamin C and E
ingredients.shortDesc: One of the reasons for hair thinning is free radical damage
ingredients.longDesc: One of the reasons for hair thinning is free radical damage. This damage blocks growth and causes your hair to age. Vitamin C and E are rich in antioxidant properties, which help against oxidative stress caused by free radicals.

ingredients.name: Vegan and Vegetarian
ingredients.shortDesc: These hair vitamins are diet-friendly, 100% vegetarian & vegan
ingredients.longDesc: These hair vitamins are diet-friendly, 100% vegetarian & vegan. NOURISH Biotin Hair Gummies have no artificial colours which disturb your diet goals. These multivitamin gummies are also Fat Free, Gluten-free, Gelatin-free and GMO-free.

faqs.question: Is there a limit to how many biotin hair gummies I can have in a day?
faqs.answer: While our gummies are yummy, we recommend you stick to having no more than one gummy a day.

faqs.question: Can these gummies help with thinning of hair?
faqs.answer: Hair thinning usually happens when hair follicles become miniaturised over time because of sensitivity to DHT - a by product of testosterone. Adequate Zinc consumption helps keep DHT in check, helping with this. The nutrients in them, like biotin, also help strengthen weak hair.

faqs.question: Will these Biotin Hair gummies help me grow my hair?
faqs.answer: While these gummies might not directly help with hair growth, they do help nourish your scalp and strength your hair follicles.

faqs.question: How are these gummies better than other Biotin tablets?
faqs.answer: In order to get positive results when supplementing with vitamins like Biotin, consistency is key. These delicious gummies are super easy to consume, helping you stay on track with your supplementation, every day. It's also fortified with additional helpful ingredients like Zinc and Vitamins A, C and E, for added benefits.

faqs.question: Do I have to take these biotin hair gummies at a specific time?
faqs.answer: It would be best if you took it at the same time daily to make sure it's a habit and you're consistently taking one gummy a day. For example, as a dessert after your lunch daily.

faqs.question: Do these Biotin Hair gummies have any side effects?
faqs.answer: No. These biotin hair gummies do not have any side effects.

faqs.question: The colour of these biotin gummies is changing over time. Is it unsafe to consume?
faqs.answer: These gummies are made from plant-based ingredients and plant-based ingredients do not have a uniform colour. The colour may range from greenish to brownish based on natural raw material variations. We do not use artificial colours to maintain the visual look of the gummies.Please note that the colour does not impact the product's efficacy, quality, shelf life, or taste.

faqs.question: How long should I have these biotin hair vitamins for best results?
faqs.answer: Improving hair texture is a long process. We would recommend having these gummies for at least 3-4 months to see visible results.
